description: This file declares the LifecycleManagerImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to application lifecycle management, state handling, configuration, and event handling within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for managing applications, handling events, and internal state management.

classes.name: LifecycleManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements application lifecycle management, state notifications, configuration, and event handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Job
